_comment: Ceilings were sized against the account balance seen 2026-09-03: 5346.5 credits, ultra plan; the account changed on 2026-09-15 (ultra, 6650.5 credits, same models verified). costCeilingCredits caps generation spend over the last costWindowHours (a rolling window read from JOB_LEDGER.csv, not state.spentCredits, which is a lifetime total); a job that would pass it is held, shown on the Queue page, and runs once older spend leaves the window. Models verified against `model list` 2026-09-03: nano_banana_2 does NOT exist as a job type; the Nano Banana 2 family is nano_banana_flash / _2_lite / _pro. Video is seedance_2_5, matching the source document. Video is generated as a 480p DRAFT first (37.5 credits vs 135 at 1080p); approving a draft in the panel queues the identical job at 1080p rather than promoting the draft. videoSound: seedance_2_5 has generate_audio (boolean, default true, verified 2026-09-15); the worker turns it on for every video job unless the job or the reviewer says otherwise. Since 2026-09-24 every Higgsfield image and video model is selectable: the list and each model's params come from worker/MODEL_CATALOG.json, which the worker fetches from `model list` / `model get` (worker/lib/models.mjs) once a day or on request. pinnedModels only orders the pickers (these first); aspectRatios / videoDurations are fallbacks for a model the catalogue does not describe, since each model's own lists win. A video model with no resolution steps (Kling 3.0, Veo) has no draft: it renders once.
